source_message.text:
Also there are a lot of Extended components which is $3 setup fee, so I have to pay $44 just for setup even resistors and capaticors. Please check the image.
Maybe we use non standard for the size 0603 vs 0805 or something like that? I mean for AXP I expected it, for caps and resistors is weird. What do you think?

value_updates.cost_optimization_goal: reduce JLCPCB assembly setup fees caused by Extended passive components
value_updates.component_selection_policy: use suitable Basic or standard resistor and capacitor alternatives where possible

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I was thinking, if you have time for a new project and are willing to do it, that we try to make as cheap as possible single board for this project. So everything will be on one board and from start we try to match JLCPCB Basica component (as much as possible). It will have much less connectors as there are no interboard connectors. Also if you have some idea on how to make something better/cheaper but have same functionality you can suggest. I can add it as new milestone to this project and we can agree on price. What do you think does it make sense?

value_updates.cost_optimization_goal: make the design as inexpensive as possible while retaining the same functionality
value_updates.connector_strategy: reduce connector count by eliminating interboard connectors
value_updates.component_selection_policy: prefer JLCPCB Basic components as much as possible
